_about: Fork: the questions of scripts/brain_eval.py. kind: knowledge (passes only without a web search), web, mixed (personal data from --seed plus the web), followup (setup turns first, in the same chat; only q is scored), privacy (must search, and no seeded private term may reach a query). expect: groups that must all match, any keyword of a group (case-insensitive). cite: the answer must contain /page/<slug> of one of them. probe: a query a sensible model would send; --dry-run checks the fake SearXNG ranks the cited page for it. Every place, shop, product and event is fictional (tests/fixtures/brain_eval/results.json). documents (a stored editor document and personal-library files, seeded with --seed): source: the answer must name one of these (the document's title or filename); tool: one of these tools must have run; editor: the created document must have opened in the editor (a doc_update event); search: a web search must have run.
